notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Rimewind Taskmage.
Rimewind Taskmage does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
description:
Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Rimewind Taskmage by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Rimewind Taskmage's ability, targeting Mana Crypt.
Resolve both abilities, untapping Rimewind Taskmage and Mana Crypt.
Repeat.
